Scene:
他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花。一吃就开始死。但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花：delete “他发现这个口味”, since it has no clear relationship with previous or following clauses; 一百岁的时候，有毒的花
- 一吃就开始死：开始不舒服，“死“ is instant, so cannot be with “开始”
- 但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒：但是即使他生病了，也告诉……，有毒

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 这个口味：一种花的味道，This is the first mention of the taste, so 这个 does not have a clear earlier noun to refer to; introduce it with a full noun phrase. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 这个口味：自己的口味，The demonstrative 这个 needs a clear previously named referent, but no particular taste has been identified; 自己的 clearly shows that the taste preference is his. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 这个口味：自己喜欢的口味，The reader does not know which specific flavour 这个 refers to; name the preference more clearly. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

output.reason: All runs identify the unclear reference in “这个口味,” but the proposed replacements retain an unrelated phrase rather than the teacher-approved deletion.
